sinUrl: The backend didn't return the authorization URL
sinPaginasDetalle: Connecting new Facebook accounts is for admins. If you already work on a page, you'll see yours here.
subtituloAdmin: Connect an account and choose which pages can be posted to.

paso1.listo: The backend has the app credentials loaded.
paso1.falta: The Meta app isn't configured in the backend yet. Create a Business-type app at developers.facebook.com and add to the .env:
paso1.permisos: Permissions to request: pages_show_list, pages_read_engagement, pages_manage_posts. Optional: read_insights (reach and impressions for the history; without it Revival still ranks, but only by reactions, comments and shares).
paso1.redirect: The redirect URI must be registered exactly the same in the app, or Meta rejects the login.

paso2.duracion: The Facebook token lasts about 60 days. When it expires you need to reconnect; enabled pages and their links are kept. Everyone connects their own account: syncing doesn't touch pages that already have another owner.
paso2.iniciaSesion: Sign in with the account that manages the fan pages.

paso3.espacio: Each enabled page is its own workspace: its review queue and project numbering are independent. Connecting doesn't enable — explicitly mark where posting is allowed.
paso3.propietario: Whoever connects a page becomes its owner. For someone else to work on it they don't need to reconnect it: invite them from <e>Team</e> and they post with the token already saved, without having to manage the fan page on Facebook.

porId.titulo: Add a page by its ID
porId.sinListado: Meta doesn't return the page list while the app has standard access. Paste the ID shown in the authorization dialog, below the page name.
porId.noAparece: If a page you authorized doesn't show up above, add it by its ID.

listo: {n, plural, one {Done: # page enabled.} other {Done: # pages enabled.}}
listoDetalle: They now show up in the sidebar switcher and as a destination when posting an approved video.

fila.soloPropietario: Only the page owner can enable it
fila.requierePermiso: Requires CREATE_CONTENT permission on the page
fila.desconectarAyuda: It stops being a posting destination. Its projects aren't deleted.

logo.seAplica: Applied to this page's recycled content
logo.sinLogoNoSe: Without a logo, recycled content can't be posted
